name: prompt-enhancer-plus
description: Prompt Enhancer++: a band above the prompt that understands a rough draft, fixes its spelling, asks only the questions that matter, names installed skills that fit, and rewrites it for the target model.

mode.title: Default mode
mode.description: quick: typo and grammar fixes only; smart: intent, structure, skills and questions when needed; deep: closer reading, staged plans and verification.

target.title: Target model
target.description: auto writes for the model this session runs and names its skills; the others write a portable prompt for another model, with no skills.

clarify.title: Clarification style
clarify.description: dialog uses Claude Code's question dialog and falls back to the band; band always asks in the row above the prompt.

askBelow.title: Ask below confidence
askBelow.description: Ask a critical question when the lowest confidence is under this (0 to 1).

assumeBelow.title: Label assumptions below confidence
assumeBelow.description: Under this confidence the prompt lists its assumptions (0 to 1).

riskAskBelow.title: Ask on risky work below confidence
riskAskBelow.description: Production data, deletion, deployment, payments, permissions or secrets: ask under this confidence (0 to 1).

maxRounds.title: Most clarification rounds
maxRounds.description: How many questions one enhancement may ask (0 to 5).
